summary: First-principles design review, iteration 4 (full record in review_loop/scrutiny_04.md). The central finding is a coherence flaw between the spec's own thesis and its confirmatory machinery: GOLD_STANDARD SS0 declares the headline 'a diversity claim, not a leaderboard claim', yet R6.5 made the COVERAGE gain the sole pre-registered endpoint, leaving the diversity half descriptive-only — and a new derivation shows that coverage endpoint was predictably power-doomed: the exact sign-flip p-value has a hard tie-imposed floor p >= 2^(1+z-n), so at n=10 reaching p<0.05 requires >=6 instances with nonzero same-direction gains, which lumpy 0/1 coverage gains on easy instances will frequently fail by ties alone. Fixed before any data exist: R6.5 is now a fixed-sequence (gatekeeping) confirmatory family — H1 = rarefied distinct-patch gain at matched k* (the title claim; near-continuous, rarely ties), then H2 = matched-k* diverse-pass@k gain tested only if H1 rejects — FWER 0.05 with no alpha splitting, the coverage claim strictly HARDER than before (needs its own p<0.05 AND H1 upstream), and min_achievable_p now reported beside every p-value (implemented + tested, incl. the m=6 boundary where the floor 0.03125 is attained). Second substantive find: the post-hoc tau sweep was numerically unfaithful to the orchestrator at exactly the grid taus it sweeps — the 3-decimal Entropy log line rounds across gate boundaries (partition (2,2,1) of 5 = 1.054920 logs as 1.055 > 1.0549, so the sweep branched where a real run gates; (3,1,1)=0.950271 logs as 0.950, the reverse; one existing test had even pinned the unfaithful semantics). Fixed by recomputing the entropy EXACTLY from the logged cluster partition (discrete SE is a deterministic partition function) with a tolerance fallback that preserves kernel/von-Neumann values flagged rather than 'corrected', full-precision grid, 1e-9 boundary epsilon, 6-decimal logging going forward, and a regression test on the (2,2,1) boundary. Third: R3.3's fixed-N comparability premise was unverified — StrategyProposer.propose can return fewer than 5 strategies (parse failure / short rejection pass), putting such instances on a DIFFERENT entropy quantization grid; the sweep now reports realized N per instance, grids on the modal N, and flags non_modal_n_instances for exclusion from pooled tau/strata analyses. Also fixed: trace.jsonl recorded a hardcoded proposer temperature of 1.0 regardless of the actual sample_temperature (misrecorded determinism knob in the exact artifact a reproducer would consult); predictions loaders now dedupe (instance_id, trajectory_id) keep-last so re-running the append-mode resample driver cannot silently inflate n/k/rarefaction denominators; selected-pass@1's structural arm asymmetry is now measured and disclosed (on the branching arm all signatures are typically unique by construction, so 'majority' degenerates to earliest-seen tie-break — degenerate_tiebreak reported per instance and per arm, no new selector invented post-hoc); per-arm rarefied distinct levels at k* added so the RESULTS table row is actually computable; and RESULTS SS7's stale 'no figure script' gap note corrected (make_figures.py exists and is render-tested). Two spec amendments applied under ratchet v2 with rationale + rejected alternatives + the hostile read answered (applied_04_hierarchical_confirmatory_family.md, applied_04_realized_n_and_gate_precision.md); neither flips anything to pass for the existing artifact — the GPU runs have not happened, all added obligations were implemented and tested this same iteration, and the coverage bar moved UP. 69 tests pass (was 63; +7 new, 1 corrected to orchestrator-faithful semantics), py_compile clean, driver --help smokes pass, compute_metrics and tau_sweep re-verified end-to-end on the real results/branching artifacts. Because real design flaws were found and fixed, gold_standard_met is FALSE per the charter; the loop should pass once more over the post-amendment design.

issues_found.title: Spec/thesis incoherence: SS0 declares a DIVERSITY headline but R6.5's only confirmatory endpoint was the coverage gain, leaving the title claim descriptive-only
issues_found.rationale: A hostile reviewer reads the old design as 'the title claim is carried by descriptive statistics; the one pre-registered test is the leaderboard number'. Fixed pre-data with a fixed-sequence family (H1 rarefied distinct gain -> H2 coverage gain), FWER 0.05, coverage bar strictly raised, full rationale + hostile read in applied_04_hierarchical_confirmatory_family.md.

issues_found.title: Exact sign-flip test has a tie-imposed power floor p >= 2^(1+z-n) — at n=10, p<0.05 needs >=6 nonzero same-direction gains — and the design neither computed nor disclosed it
issues_found.rationale: The 0/1 coverage gain will tie often on easy instances, so the old primary was predictably at risk of an uninterpretable null read as 'no effect'. min_achievable_sign_flip_p implemented, tested at the attained m=6 boundary (0.03125), reported beside every p, disclosed pre-run in RESULTS SS2.2/SS6.

issues_found.title: Post-hoc tau sweep disagreed with real-run gate semantics at exactly the achievable-grid taus: 3-decimal log rounding crosses gate boundaries ((2,2,1)=1.054920 logs as 1.055>1.0549; (3,1,1)=0.950271 logs as 0.950)
issues_found.rationale: The R3.3 zero-GPU equivalence claim is only true if the reconstruction is numerically faithful. Entropy now recomputed exactly from the logged cluster partition (with a flagged fallback that never 'corrects' kernel/von-Neumann values), full-precision grid, boundary epsilon, 6-decimal logging; regression test pins the boundary; one pre-existing test had asserted the unfaithful semantics and was corrected.

issues_found.title: R3.3's fixed-N premise was unverified: the proposer can return <5 strategies, silently placing instances on a different entropy quantization grid, with realized N reported nowhere
issues_found.rationale: Hard run-time enforcement was rejected (retry-until-parse changes the proposal distribution); instead realized N is measured per instance, the grid uses the modal N, non-modal instances are flagged and excluded from pooled tau/strata analyses (spec + RESULTS threat 9).

issues_found.title: selected-pass@1 is structurally asymmetric across arms: on the branching arm 'majority' typically degenerates to the earliest-seen tie-break because patches are one-per-cluster by construction
issues_found.rationale: Side-by-side selected-pass@1 without this caveat quietly favors whichever arm the tie-break blesses. Now measured (majority_multiplicity, degenerate_tiebreak, per-arm count) and disclosed in RESULTS SS3/R4.4; no new selector invented post-hoc (the dominant-cluster rule already exists as the largest-tau row of the tau sweep).

issues_found.title: trace.jsonl recorded a hardcoded proposer temperature of 1.0 regardless of the actual sample_temperature; predictions loaders trusted append-mode files (re-runs silently inflate n); RESULTS SS7 claimed a figure-script gap that does not exist
issues_found.rationale: All three are artifact-truthfulness defects: a misrecorded determinism knob in the artifact a reproducer would consult, a metric-layer non-idempotence to a documented re-run workflow, and a stale doc claim. Fixed (tracer reads proposer.temperature; (iid,tid) dedupe keep-last + test; SS7 corrected).
